skirmish.module.hw_tooltips.name: HolyWorld Tooltips
skirmish.module.hw_tooltips.description: HolyWorld wiki facts in item tooltips: what each TNT type breaks, the stun's cube and time, sphere rarities and costs, talisman and rune effects, mystery egg odds, backpack slots, armour repair rules.
skirmish.module.hw_tooltips.setting.when: Always, or only while Shift is held
skirmish.module.hw_tooltips.setting.shif: A "Shift — HolyWorld facts" line while Shift is not held
skirmish.module.hw_tooltips.setting.armo: On any armour: how Unbreaking works and what can repair it on HolyWorld
skirmish.module.hw_tooltips.setting.holy: No extra lines on other servers
skirmish.hw_items.fact.tnt.privates_basi: Breaks iron, gold, diamond and emerald-ore region blocks; not netherite or unique ones
skirmish.hw_items.fact.tnt.radius_normal: Blast radius of a normal TNT
skirmish.hw_items.fact.tnt.obsidian: Breaks obsidian and netherite (and unique) region blocks
skirmish.hw_items.fact.tnt.raid_block: Blown-up obsidian gets a raid block for 5 minutes: no obsidian blocks can be placed there
skirmish.hw_items.fact.tnt.no_terrain: Does not destroy blocks around it
skirmish.hw_items.fact.tnt_a.radius: Blast radius 3 times a normal TNT
skirmish.hw_items.fact.tnt_b.radius: Blast radius 10 times a normal TNT
skirmish.hw_items.fact.blast_wave.durabi: Takes 2 durability off a region block
skirmish.hw_items.fact.blast_wave.source: Not craftable: events, treasuries, /warp unique, /shop, /create from C4
skirmish.hw_items.fact.stealer.chance: Next to a spawner: the spawner drops with a 50% chance
Next to a spawner: the spawner drops with a 75% chance
skirmish.hw_items.fact.ice_wave.ice: An ice sphere of radius 2 for 5 seconds
skirmish.hw_items.fact.tnt_long.fuse: Explodes 8 seconds after ignition (a normal one after 4)
skirmish.hw_items.fact.explosive.use: Component of advanced explosives (B2, stun, traps)
skirmish.hw_items.fact.tnt_cannon.launch: Launches TNT up to 5 blocks per second
skirmish.hw_items.fact.tnt_cannon.keeps: Launched TNT keeps all its properties
skirmish.hw_items.fact.raid_block.what: Forbids placing obsidian, crying obsidian, ender chests, ancient debris, enchanting tables and anchors
skirmish.hw_items.fact.raid_block.who: Applies to everyone: raiders and region members alike
skirmish.hw_items.fact.custom.rune_combi: Combines with a totem of undying on an anvil
skirmish.hw_items.fact.stun.pearls: No ender pearls or chorus fruit inside the cube
skirmish.hw_items.fact.stun.slowness: Slowness I on everyone but the user
skirmish.hw_items.fact.stun.craft: Craft: 6 spider eyes, 2 blaze powder, 1 explosive substance
skirmish.hw_items.fact.trap.effect: Damage within 3 blocks and a temporary box
skirmish.hw_items.fact.trap_explosive.ef: Damage within 3 blocks and a crater in the ground
skirmish.hw_items.fact.trap_explosive.cr: Craft: 1 redstone, 2 explosive substance, 2 sand, 4 blaze powder
skirmish.hw_items.fact.special_compass.u: Right click: points to the nearest or a random treasury
skirmish.hw_items.fact.jake_pickaxe.spaw: A spawner broken with it drops with its mob
skirmish.hw_items.fact.jake_pickaxe.priv: Takes spawners even from other players' regions
Immortality rune: 3 seconds of invulnerability after the totem pops
Restoration rune: full health after the totem pops
Sold in the buyer's shop /b shop
skirmish.hw_items.fact.universal_key.bos: Summons bosses on the PvP arena
skirmish.hw_items.fact.elytra_armored.ar: Protects like a diamond chestplate and still flies
skirmish.hw_items.fact.sun_helmet.unbrea: Netherite helmet, fully unbreakable, can be enchanted
skirmish.hw_items.fact.cerberus_sword.st: The strongest sword of the mode: Sharpness 9, Critical 2, Destroyer 3
skirmish.hw_items.fact.boom_thing.effect: Right click: an explosion that kills an unarmoured player within 3 blocks
skirmish.hw_items.fact.jake_lamp.effect: Right click: players without a helmet within 15 blocks get a pumpkin and glowing for 15 seconds
skirmish.hw_items.fact.xp_bubble.repair: Repairs Mending items: item in the main hand, bubble in the off hand, right click
skirmish.hw_items.fact.snowball.effect: On hit: Slowness VI and Blindness for 10 seconds
skirmish.hw_items.fact.unbreakable_anvil: Does not wear out with use
skirmish.hw_items.fact.fast_furnace.effe: Smelts much faster than a normal furnace
skirmish.hw_items.fact.artifact.effect: Holds several experience keeper effects at once
skirmish.hw_items.fact.artifact.combine: An effect is added on an anvil for 10 levels
skirmish.hw_items.fact.xp_bottle.exchang: XP turns into bottles with /exp (level 100 cannot be exchanged)
skirmish.hw_items.fact.xp_bottle.repair: Repairs a Mending tool: tool in the main hand, bottle in the off hand
skirmish.hw_items.fact.golden_spawner.sp: Kills ~10 mobs per second, ~60 times faster than a normal spawner
skirmish.hw_items.fact.golden_spawner.sw: A sword in the sword slot lends its enchantments (Farmer, Looting)
skirmish.hw_items.fact.golden_spawner.cr: Craft: 8 spawners of any kind and a nether star
skirmish.hw_items.fact.golden_spawner.eg: One egg lasts 8–10 thousand mobs; each new egg raises the break chance: 1.9%, 5.3%, 9.7%, 15%…
skirmish.hw_items.fact.keeper_hunter.eff: Experience keeper: 50% of the XP on a player kill
skirmish.hw_items.fact.keeper_snowman.ef: Experience keeper: 2% chance of Slowness for 5 s on hit
skirmish.hw_items.fact.keeper_illuminato: Experience keeper: 5% chance of Glowing for 15 s on hit
skirmish.hw_items.fact.keeper_enderman.e: Experience keeper: 50% chance to keep the ender pearl
skirmish.hw_items.fact.keeper_anti_phant: Experience keeper: attacking phantoms die instantly
skirmish.hw_items.fact.keeper_telekinesi: Experience keeper: 3 s of exclusive loot pickup after a kill
Experience keeper: 2% chance of Regeneration II on hit
skirmish.hw_items.fact.keeper_justice.ef: Experience keeper: immune to blindness, jump boost, poison, wither, slowness and weakness
skirmish.hw_items.fact.sphere.offhand: Effects work while the sphere is in the off hand
skirmish.hw_items.fact.sphere.cost: Conversion cost: common 30 levels, epic 50, legendary 60, mythic 100
skirmish.hw_items.fact.sphere.shards: Smelting gives sphere shards, exchanged at the Spheromancer /spheres
skirmish.hw_items.fact.sphere.mythic_rec: Epic + legendary on an anvil → mythic
skirmish.hw_items.fact.sphere.unique: Unique: cannot be crafted or turned into a talisman
skirmish.hw_items.fact.sphere_common.mer: Two common on an anvil → epic
skirmish.hw_items.fact.sphere_epic.merge: Two epic on an anvil → legendary
skirmish.hw_items.fact.sphere_mythic.lev: The level II effect of the epic and the level III effect of the legendary sphere
skirmish.hw_items.fact.sphere_shard.exch: Exchanged for spheres at the Spheromancer /spheres
skirmish.hw_items.fact.talisman.what: Totem of undying + sphere: totem properties plus the sphere's effects from the off hand
skirmish.hw_items.fact.talisman.backpack: Cannot be taken out of a backpack during PvP
skirmish.hw_items.fact.backpack.shulker_: 2+ backpacks in the inventory: "shulker mode", all shulkers and backpacks drop when you log out
skirmish.hw_items.fact.backpack.pvp: Totems and talismans cannot be taken out during PvP
skirmish.hw_items.fact.egg.mystery_use: Right click a spawner: its mob becomes a random one from the egg's list
skirmish.hw_items.fact.egg_witch.odds: Piglin brute 25%, witch 7%, blaze 20%, zombie 18%, skeleton 30%
skirmish.hw_items.fact.egg_piglin.odds: Piglin brute 50%, witch 4%, baby zombie 20%, creeper 1%, blaze 25%
skirmish.hw_items.fact.egg_creeper.odds: Piglin brute 33%, creeper 2%, blaze 17.5%, zombie 17.5%, skeleton 30%
skirmish.hw_items.fact.egg_salmon.odds: 12.5% each: stray, piglin brute, baby zombie, husk, blaze, zombified piglin, vindicator, pillager
skirmish.hw_items.fact.egg_mystery.kinds: Kinds: witch, piglin, creeper, parrot, salmon; /b shop, events, /create
skirmish.hw_items.fact.egg_shard.exchang: Egg keeper /eggkeeper: 16 — common rarity, 48 — raised, 64 — high
skirmish.hw_items.fact.spawn_egg.upgrade: /create: … → Blaze → Piglin brute → Ghast → Mystery egg
skirmish.hw_items.fact.spawn_egg.golden: In a golden spawner: 8–10 thousand mobs per egg
skirmish.hw_items.fact.armor.unbreaking: Unbreaking: chance to keep durability = 47 + 10 × level % (V = 97%)
skirmish.hw_items.fact.armor.no_repair: No Mending on armour; /fix and normal anvil repairs do not work on armour
skirmish.hw_items.fact.armor.ingots: Repaired on an anvil with netherite ingots: 1 ingot = +25 durability
skirmish.hw_items.fact.armor.drops: Breaking this armour on an opponent makes them drop netherite ingots
